## What is still open
- The window moved: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night, so the cutover is now **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC** — update the runbook and merge #321, which Maya has cleared [8][3].
- The rollback rehearsal on a fresh clone is still owed for Thursday 19/11: after switchover the old instance is renamed and gets no writes, so rollback is not just switching back — the runbook has it as a TODO, with time and data loss to measure [1].

## What changed
- Maya approved #321 — Terraform looks right, and she called out the replica fix as a good catch; her only condition was confirming the date with Fernhill, which she has now done herself [3][8].
- Daniel reports staging has run smoothly on PG17 since Thursday, with dashboards p95 even dropping slightly [5].
- Renovate opened #320 bumping the AWS provider 5.80 → 5.82, no automerge [4].

## What you did

- Rehearsed the full cutover on a clone of last night's prod snapshot: 74 seconds of write downtime, replication lag under 1 s, no row-count mismatches on the biggest tables — then tore the clone down to stop the spend [1].
- Wrote `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md` and opened PR #321 with Maya as reviewer, plan output in the description [1].
